item.title: test(infra): stop the ssh tunnel stderr cases hanging the suite (#128…
item.summary: test(infra): stop the ssh tunnel stderr cases hanging the suite (#128027) These two cases enable fake timers and then let the fake ssh spawn open a real loopback socket. startSshPortForward waits for that listener with setTimeout retries against a Date.now() deadline, and fake timers freeze both, so a listener that is not up on the first probe never gets a retry and never reaches its own timeout. The case then hangs until the suite timeout instead of failing on its 1000ms budget. The listener usually wins that race on an idle machine, which is why this only shows up as an occasional 120s CI timeout. Real timers make the case deterministic and cost nothing: the file still runs in about 350ms.
